services.name: Pontoon Rentals
services.desc: If luxury, comfort, and performance is what you’re looking for check out our Lake Tahoe pontoon rental boats. Park and check in directly across the street from the West Shore Café at the Homewood Ski Area parking lot. Follow SWA Watersports signage to our office. Your boat rental starts at the time of your reservation, so please arrive 30 minutes early to fill out your paperwork and receive your boat safety / operation orientation. Don’t mistake these for ordinary pontoon boats. Tritoon boats have a 3rd pontoon, which increases maneuverability, stability, and performance.
